title: Statistical Properties of Nonparametric MLE under Laplace Noise
summary: Local differential privacy (LDP) protects individuals in a dataset by perturbing each measurement before release. For real-valued data, a widely used mechanism is additive Laplace noise. We study the problem of estimating the distribution of the latent confidential data from the privatized observations via the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) under an i.i.d. sampling model.
